captions.detailed: An astrograph imaging refractor telescope mounted on a belt-driven equatorial wedge. The main optical tube is colored white with dark grey/black end caps and red accent rings, and it is secured to a dovetail saddle plate. The equatorial wedge head sits on a central dark grey pier, which is supported by a tripod with three adjustable black and silver legs. The telescope tube tilts on a saddle-clamp axis, the wedge adjusts for latitude, the right ascension axis rotates continuously, and the tripod legs extend telescopically.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an astrograph imaging refractor telescope on a belt-driven equatorial wedge mount. The assembly should feature a detailed optical tube assembly with red ring accents, a dovetail clamping saddle, an adjustable latitude wedge head, and a tripod base with three extendable legs.
captions.factory: The model is built hierarchically starting from a tripod base. The base is constructed from a central hub disk, three cylindrical upper leg struts, and three nested inner leg cylinders representing the prismatic extension. On top of the hub, a vertical pier cylinder connects to a wedge base plate. The wedge head is modeled using boolean-subtracted angled blocks for the latitude tilt mechanism. A continuous-rotation right ascension axis is modeled as a cylinder perpendicular to the polar tilt, which supports the declination saddle plate. The optical tube assembly is constructed from concentric cylinders of varying diameters, colored white, dark grey, and red, and attached to the saddle plate.
